candidates.content_text:
Junior Project Manager
Central Vic Civil | Ballarat, VIC | Full Time (Part-time considered)
Are you a recent civil engineering graduate or aspiring Project Manager looking to build your career in civil construction?
Central Vic Civil is seeking a motivated and organised Junior Project Manager to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your project management skills while working alongside experienced industry professionals on a diverse range of civil construction projects.
About Central Vic Civil
Central Vic Civil is a locally owned, family-operated business specialising in civil construction and water infrastructure. We have built a strong reputation for delivering quality projects across regional Victoria. Working primarily with State and Local Government authorities and local developers, our projects span sewer and water infrastructure, roadworks, land development and a broad range of civil construction works.
About the Role
Working closely with our Senior Project Managers and Directors, you will assist in coordinating and delivering civil construction projects from planning through to completion.
This role offers hands-on exposure to all aspects of project management, including programming, cost control, contract administration, estimating, quality assurance and site safety. You will work closely with site supervisors, subcontractors, suppliers and clients to help ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.
We are looking for someone who is eager to learn, takes initiative and is ready to grow with the business.
Key Responsibilities
- Assist with planning and delivery of civil construction projects.
- Monitor project budgets, costs, schedules and progress.
- Coordinate with site supervisors to ensure works meet project timelines.
- Assist with tendering, estimating and supplier/subcontractor quotations.
- Manage project documentation, reporting, variations and cost tracking.
- Ensure quality, safety and environmental requirements are met.
- Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers and internal teams.
About You
We are looking for a driven individual with strong organisational skills, a practical mindset and a genuine interest in civil construction.
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- A relevant degree in Civil Engineering or Project Management.
- Civil construction industry experience (Highly Regarded).
- Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Good analytical, mathematical and computer skills.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.
- Current driver's licence and Construction Induction Card (White Card).
Why Join Central Vic Civil?
- Career Development: Learn from experienced industry professionals.
- Variety of Projects: Gain hands-on experience across water infrastructure, roadworks and land development.
- Supportive Team: Join a local, family-owned business that values teamwork and quality.
- Growth Opportunities: Build your skills and progress your career in civil construction.
Apply Now
If you are a recent graduate or early-career professional looking to take the next step in civil construction, we would love to hear from you.
Apply through SEEK with your resume and a cover letter outlining your qualifications, experience and interest in the role.
